difficulty_reason: The lemma identifies the restriction of a derived pushforward to a localized site with the derived pushforward of the restriction along the induced morphism of localized sites (statement lines 4373-4385). The proof chooses a K-injective representative so that the pushforward is computed explicitly (proof lines 4387-4395) and then compares the sections over the objects of the localized source, using that restriction preserves K-injectivity (proof lines 4395-4400). The non-formal content is the identification of the two localized computations. The claim is H2: one representative choice plus one comparison.
